notes.title: Robber's shack update
notes.content:
Hello! Robber's shack was updated. You may notice script in robber's shack level was a little bit rough. I am happy to announce that I spent quite a some time improving it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/2a8504e4fad4c24b83f7ddcf5ba9e6bb4b56742b.png[/img]

There were many minor bugs: camera movement wasn't smooth enough, positioning was a little bit inaccurate, animations require some improvement. But one bug was special, I called it Angry Ghost. In very rare situation robber kid could dissapear, and the game keep going like nothing happend. I think this is just hilarious.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/9e25dde098966884a92577377285f7265fe7c51d.png[/img]

Anyways, the script is already fixed, the robber's shack looks much better now.

notes.title: Midnight Quest is coming on May 17th
notes.content:
After ten month of development, I'm pleased to announce that Midnight Quest will be released on the 17th of May.

Updated trailer and screenshots are coming soon.

notes.title: Release date changed again. Sorry about this.
notes.content:
I am sorry. I have to change release date. I know that many people are waiting for the game and I know that I changed release date in the past. Please take my sincere apologies for making you wait.

I am in tough situation when I have to choose between making people wait and releasing rough unpolished game. I spent last 7 month working on this game and it is very important for me. I know that after I click "Release" button the game will become visible for huge steam audience that has high expectations for quality. If a game is low quality most players will play it once and never come back to it, some of them will post negative review that may stay forever regardless of improvements or fixes. 

My point is that as a developer I need to provide good game from day one, little rush with a release may ruin month of work.

I hope you understand me.

(Today I noticed that I don't have to set scecific release date, I can specify only release month. I didn't notice this option before today. I think that this way of specifieng release date more suited to my style of work. This should put an end to constant changing of release date.)

notes.title: Help translate Midnight Quest into your language!
notes.content:
Do you know great feeling whan you see that game you like is translated to your native language?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135751/581b05a78d34667cb21497d220d67d7ae30c2d88.png[/img]

I'd love to make Midnight Quest as accessible to as wide an audience as possible, so I am looking for help translating the game into other languages! I am trying to use as little text as possible in the game, it's only 225 words in English - easy!


If you'd like to help, simply grab  [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/1ggvv2m81cl1y9u/Midnight%20Quest%20English.txt?dl=1]this file[/url], and open it in your favourite text editor. You should see lines like this:

[code]14: New game
15: Settings
16: Credits[/code]

You can see line number and English text in the line, simply replace English phrases with phrases in your language. 

Once you're done, email the file to me at [b]sergeyromanko@gmail.com[/b].

Check below if your language is already translated! Don't see your language: then get in touch and I can almost certainly add it!

[b]Translation Status :[/b]
[list]
[*]Russian: ✓ completed
[*]Spanish: ✓ completed
[*]French: ✓ completed
[*]Italian: ✓ completed
[*]German: ✓ completed
[*]Swedish: not done
[*]Polish: not done 
[*]Portuguese: not done 
[*]Brazil Portuguese: ✓ completed
[*]Chinese Traditional: not done
[*]Chinese Simplified: ✓ completed
[*]Japanese: not done
[*]Korean: not done
[*]Norwegian: ✓ completed
[*]Dutch: ✓ completed
[*]Ukrainian: ✓ completed
[*]Polish: ✓ completed
[/list]

If you start a translation, please post here so I can update the list.
Your help is extremely important for me and other players!
